items.text:
Retiring at year end with employer coverage, and already 65? You generally have 8 months after the job or the coverage ends, whichever comes first, to sign up for Part B without a late penalty. COBRA does not extend that window. Your 6-month Medigap open enrollment period starts when Part B starts. We help you line up the dates so coverage does not lapse. Call (571) 354-0146.

We do not offer every plan available in your area. Any information we provide is limited to those plans we do offer in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
